topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger records a recognition-to-text decoder for a speech-related signal (any modality: EMG, ECoG, intracortical, EEG, video, ultrasound, NAM) and names phones, a lexicon/dictionary, an n-gram/language model, an HMM or CTC; the design compared is how sub-word units become words: HMM/GMM phone models with a pronunciation dictionary and n-gram LM, CTC-trained neural networks, or LLM rescoring. Boundary: a study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound); closed-set word classifiers without a recognition-to-text route are outside; versions once.
topics.design_field: M06 model_family (slot-filled) plus full-text regexes hmm_or_gmm_phone_models, neural_ctc, ngram_language_model, pronunciation_dictionary, llm_rescoring

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: neural speech decoders that constrain output with a vocabulary of at least 1,000 words via an n-gram or neural language model at use time; 50-word or command sets count as small vocabulary.
Reused published table: neural text decoders; whether WER is measured on sentences absent from training or on repeats.
Reused published table: neural decoding studies testing against an empirical null built by shuffling or permuting labels, trials, time or channels.
